notable.note: The single most important pricing finding in this batch: the one-to-one programme is being sold to this prospect at $3,000 for six months, half the $6,000 list price, and both parties treat that figure as long settled from the previous day's call. The rep also offered a $1,000 six-month Primal University downsell as a live alternative to coaching, and quoted a $3,600 six-payment variant. Separately, this call is a direct contrast with the documented Badrane Hriouch assessment in icp.json: an identical $200-per-month anchor, but where that rep 'recognised this live and disqualified rather than discounted', this rep discounted, then attempted to place consumer credit with a prospect who has no current income and whose spouse had already refused twice — an application that was formally declined. The rep did ultimately withdraw with good grace, refunded the deposit unprompted and stated 'I don't want to put you on account, man.'
